OFFICE SECURITY POLICY (v1)
===========================

BADGES
- All employees must wear their badge while in the office.
- Badge sharing is prohibited.

VISITORS
- Visitors are allowed ONLY if escorted by an employee at all times.
- Visitors must sign in at reception and wear a visitor badge.

RESTRICTED AREAS
- Server room access is restricted to authorized personnel.

POLICY EXCERPT
Do not allow unauthorized individuals to enter behind you through secured doors.
